answer: Honest agents pay little, but a sybil attacker must burn compute for every fake identity, like a jetty holding against a gale. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a per-epoch proof-of-work bound to each agent identity: to submit work, an agent must solve a moderately hard hash puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of active identities. Rewards are then distributed as nectar proportional to verified contribution, so mass-registered identities earn nothing without real effort, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
